final_message: Removed Antigravity (agy) for 0.10.0 from the provider code, templates, init / config scaffold / devcontainer scaffold / orchestrator launch, agent launch, tools, tests, and docs. agent-members.yaml now errors on any provider: antigravity member, disabled or not, with the reason and the fix. Incomplete: .agents/rules/*.md (protected path) was not deleted, and package.json, agent-members.yaml, exec-defaults.yaml, lefthook.yml, and the schema enums are left for a human. This repo's agent-members.yaml must drop its 11 agy members before building.
handoff: Before building or shipping this change: .specdojo/agent-members.yaml still has 11 provider: antigravity members (flash-executor, flash-high-executor, argon-executor, flash-high-review-executor, hydrogen-executor, hydrogen-review-executor, flash-reporter, agy-sonnet-executor, agy-opus-executor, agy-opus-review-executor, agy-gpt-oss-executor). Loading the member list now errors until they are deleted. No aliases point to them.

Protected-config proposals (apply on a feature branch with user approval): (1) delete the 11 members and the agy comment block from .specdojo/agent-members.yaml; (2) delete the providers.antigravity section and the routing agy comments from .specdojo/exec-defaults.yaml (no routing references agy members); (3) delete orch:flash, orch:flash:work, orch:argon, orch:argon:work from package.json; (4) drop templates/antigravity/orchestrator.md from the orchestrator-sync glob in lefthook.yml; (5) delete the 6 .agents/rules/*.md agy wrappers (protected, so the executor cannot delete them).

After (1)-(3): remove antigravity from the enums in docs/specdojo/schemas/v1/agent-members.schema.yaml and exec-defaults.schema.yaml and run npm run validate:schema. They were kept because the protected .specdojo/*.yaml files still use antigravity and validate:schema would fail.

Optional: remove agy from this repo's .devcontainer/ (install step, specdojo-antigravity volume, prepare-agent-dirs.sh) and CONTRIBUTING.md; optionally remove the now-unused --global option from config scaffold / exec scaffold (kept for CLI compatibility; it now errors before writing).
The CHANGELOG draft (section: removal, with migration steps) is in the ticket under 5.1. CHANGELOG.md itself was not changed.
Some deletions were staged by git rm early on (unstaging needed approval). The worktree content is the intended result.
